title: Power Automate process mining: Process Intelligence Studio for object-centric models
summary: Hold: the page incorrectly reports that automation for restricting add-on capacity assignments is undocumented. Microsoft documents a tenant-setting update command and the capacity-allocation setting it can update. The roadmap facts and the printed capacity-allocation API are supported; the licensing model and API formatting need minor corrections.

claims.claim: The printed PATCH call and currencyAllocations body allocate ProcessMiningDataStorage capacity using API version 2024-10-01.
claims.quote: PATCH https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/environments/{environmentId}/allocations?api-version=2024-10-01; currencyAllocations; allocated: integer (int32); currencyType: ExternalCurrencyType; ProcessMiningDataStorage
claims.fix: Replace the call, in front matter and the rendered table, with 'PATCH https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/environments/{environmentId}/allocations?api-version=2024-10-01'. Add the note: 'The request body sets currencyAllocations with currencyType ProcessMiningDataStorage and allocated.' The printed body keys are correct, but the standard puts them in the note.

claims.claim: Settings > Power Platform settings > Tenant settings > Add-on capacity assignments > Only specific admins restricts who can allocate add-on capacity.
claims.quote: In the title bar, select the Settings icon. ... Select Power Platform settings. ... On the Tenant settings page, select Add-on capacity assignments, and then select Only specific admins.

claims.claim: Automation for restricting who may allocate add-on capacity is not yet documented.
claims.quote: pac admin update-tenant-settings: Update tenant settings. --setting-name: Name of the setting to be updated. --setting-value: Value of the setting to be updated.
claims.fix: Replace controls[1].api null with kind pac-cli, call 'pac admin update-tenant-settings --setting-name disableCapacityAllocationByEnvironmentAdmins --setting-value true', and docs https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/developer/cli/reference/admin#pac-admin-update-tenant-settings; update the table to match. The existing cited https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/list-tenantsettings#definitions defines this Boolean as disabling capacity allocation by environment administrators. Add the CLI reference to sources. The narrow Set-TenantSettings-reference caveat may remain, but it does not justify reporting all automation absent.

claims.claim: The preview list-tenantsettings documentation defines disableCapacityAllocationByEnvironmentAdmins.
claims.quote: This is a preview feature. ... disableCapacityAllocationByEnvironmentAdmins | Boolean | Ability to disable capacity allocation by environment administrators. Default value is false.

claims.claim: The Set-TenantSettings reference does not document a PowerShell call specifically for disableCapacityAllocationByEnvironmentAdmins.
claims.quote: Searched: 'disableCapacityAllocationByEnvironmentAdmins update tenant settings API Set-TenantSettings'. Read the full Set-TenantSettings reference: RequestBody and ApiVersion parameters; WalkMeOptOut example; no capacity-allocation property.
claims.fix: Date this narrow reference-check statement 'at the time of writing (November 2026)' and add https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/microsoft.powerapps.administration.powershell/set-tenantsettings to sources.

claims.claim: For event logs stored in Azure Data Lake, process access has storage-role prerequisites.
claims.quote: all users that have the Owner or Co-Owner role on the process must be attributed: Storage Blob Data Reader or Storage Blob Data Contributor role assigned; Azure Resource Manager Reader role assigned, at minimum.

claims.claim: For OneLake event logs, access depends on Fabric workspace setup and permissions.
claims.quote: The Admin role must be attributed to the user performing the initial workspace setup ... The Fabric workspace needs to be shared to the Process Insight Prod service principal with an Admin role.

claims.claim: The allocating-add-ons tutorial demonstrates the allocation API through a Power Automate flow.
claims.quote: Allocate an add-on using Power Automate flows or Logic Apps ... searching for "Allocate and deallocate the currencies for the environment". Set the parameters to higher numeric values to perform assignment.
